entry.title: Economic development · Mon, Nov 2, 2026
entry.summary:
Proposed: Performance Agreement for Salem Avenue Parking Structure. The agenda recommended action on executing a performance agreement between the City, the Economic Development Authority of the City of Roanoke, and Shadwell Properties, LLC, for costs associated with securing the parking structure at 33 Salem Avenue SW.

entry.title: Economic development · Mon, Jul 20, 2026
entry.summary:
Adopted: State Appropriation for RoVa Labs Anchor Tenant Development. Council approved a resolution accepting a $4 million appropriation from the Commonwealth of Virginia to develop lab space and secure an anchor tenant at RoVa Labs, located at 1030 South Jefferson Street. Recorded vote: 7-0.
Official source: https://roanokeva.api.civicclerk.com/v1/Meetings/GetMeetingFileStream(fileId=6524,plainText=false)

entry.title: Economic development · Mon, Jun 15, 2026
entry.summary:
Adopted: Downtown Service District Services Agreement. Council adopted an ordinance approving a service agreement between the City of Roanoke and Downtown Roanoke Incorporated for the Downtown Service District. Recorded vote: 6-0.
Adopted: Williamson Road Area Service District Agreement. Council approved an ordinance authorizing the Williamson Road Area Service District Agreement between the City of Roanoke and the Greater Williamson Road Area Business Association. Recorded vote: 6-0.
Adopted: Performance Agreement for RINGANA Cosmetics Manufacturing Facility. Council adopted two ordinances approving the execution of a Commonwealth Opportunity Fund Grant performance agreement among the City, EDA, VEDP, and RINGANA entities for constructing and operating a cosmetics manufacturing facility. Recorded vote: 6-0.
Discussion / report: Follow-Up on Mill Mountain Tourism Revenue Ideas. The Inclusive Services Manager noted that a resident's suggestions regarding Mill Mountain tourism revenue generation were forwarded to the Parks and Recreation Department, although no contact details were provided.
Proposed: Pedestrianization Initiative for Market Street and Wall Street. Council Member Volosin submitted a Council Member Initiative to pedestrianize Market Street and Wall Street in downtown, aiming to discuss it at the July Council meeting alongside downtown business stakeholders.
Official source: https://roanokeva.api.civicclerk.com/v1/Meetings/GetMeetingFileStream(fileId=6502,plainText=false)

entry.title: Economic development · Mon, Jun 1, 2026
entry.summary:
Discussion / report: Greater Williamson Road Area Business Association 'State of the Road' Report. Council received and filed a presentation of the 'State of the Road' report delivered by Valerie Brown, Executive Director of the Greater Williamson Road Area Business Association.
Adopted: Amendment No. 3 to Economic Development Performance Agreement for Riverdale. City Council adopted Ordinance No. 43405-060126 authorizing officials to execute Amendment No. 3 to an Economic Development Performance Agreement between the City, the Economic Development Authority, and Riverdale Southeast, LLC, Riverdale Woods, LLC, Industry Drive Partners, LLC, 802 River Avenue, LLC, 826 River Avenue, LLC, Riverdale Med I, LLC, and Riverdale WL, LLC. Recorded vote: 7-0.

entry.title: Economic development · Mon, May 18, 2026
entry.summary:
Adopted: Virginia Business Ready Sites Program Grant for Tract 8. City Council adopted Ordinance No. 43392-051826 accepting and appropriating a Virginia Business Ready Sites Program Grant for site development of Tract 8. Recorded vote: 6-1.
Discussion / report: Public Information Updates on Recycling Delays and Northwest Economic Development. Staff provided follow-up details on public communications, including TV graphics addressing recycling pick-up delays, and summarized community engagement outreach regarding Northwest Roanoke economic development initiatives including the Main Street America program and Melrose Plaza.

entry.title: Economic development · Mon, Oct 5, 2026
entry.summary:
Hearing scheduled: Public Hearing on Enterprise Zone One A Boundary Amendments. City Council concurred in a request to schedule and advertise a public hearing on October 19, 2026, regarding proposed boundary amendments to Enterprise Zone One A.
Adopted: Small Business Development Center Funding Acceptance and Appropriation. Council adopted an ordinance accepting and appropriating additional funds for the Greater Roanoke and New River Valley Small Business Development Center for fiscal year 2027. Recorded vote: 7-0.
Adopted: Congressional Directed Spending Grant for RoVa Labs Equipment. Council voted 6-1 to adopt an ordinance accepting FY26 Congressional Directed Spending grant award funds from the U.S. Small Business Administration to purchase laboratory equipment for RoVa Labs. Vice-Mayor McGuire voted no. Recorded vote: 6-1.
Discussion / report: Mayor's Fall Business Summit Announcement. City staff provided information on the upcoming Mayor's Fall Business Summit, announcing that online registration was open for the October 29 event.
Official source: https://roanokeva.api.civicclerk.com/v1/Meetings/GetMeetingFileStream(fileId=6579,plainText=false)

entry.title: Economic development · Mon, Oct 19, 2026
entry.summary:
Adopted: Economic Development Authority Director Appointment. Council voted 7-0 to adopt Resolution No. 43485-101926, appointing a Director to the Economic Development Authority for the City of Roanoke. Recorded vote: 7-0.
Adopted: Enterprise Zone One A Boundary Amendments. Following a public hearing, City Council voted 7-0 to adopt Resolution No. 43488-101926, approving boundary amendments to Enterprise Zone One A. Recorded vote: 7-0.
